description: Deviation handling for a GMP-regulated Life Science company: Registration → Coordination → Root cause investigation → QA assessment/closure. Inbox groups (deviation leader group, QA assessor group) pick or assign the individual role holder via a button. Classification (Critical/Major/Minor/Observation) drives which fields are shown and mandatory; observations are quick-closed in Coordination. ERP integration fetches article data from batch number. E-signature on quick close and on forward from investigation and QA.

notes:
Reference configuration EX-26714 (Workflow – Avvikelse – Life Science, Pharma), translated to English.

Rules in the original (CANEA rule engine):
- Registration: mandatory fields on forward; e-mail to Deviation leader group on forward; product/analysis fields hidden unless the Yes/No field = Yes; integration result hidden for all but admin; web service calls on the buttons (batch number → article number/name).
- Coordination: mandatory fields on forward & quick close; Observation → mandatory 'Observation – additional correction' and quick close only (error message if sent forward); Critical/Major/Minor → forward only (error message on quick close); fields editable only for the Deviation leader (the group may only edit 'Select deviation leader'); e-signature on quick close; e-mail to initiator on backward.
- Root cause investigation: mandatory fields per classification; 'Confirmed OOS/OOE/OOT?' mandatory if 'Analysis affected' = Yes; risk assessment text hidden for Critical/Major (document used), documents hidden for Minor; CAPA hidden for Minor + first time/occasional; e-signature on forward.
- QA assessment: fields editable only for the QA assessor (the group may only edit 'Select/change QA assessor'); e-signature on forward.

Inbox groups: when cases appear in the group inboxes, users in the group roles can pick the case themselves or assign it to a colleague, who is notified after the button is clicked in phase 2/4.
